primary_object_card.object_statement: A bounded selector compares every oriented cyclic word of lengths two through eight over the declared Ti/Te/Fi/Fe source family on the exact sixteen source slots without receiving four or an authored target, and may select four only if one shared cycle uniquely wins both chirality schedules under preregistered margins, scenario coverage, and kill controls.

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: Sixteen source slots are split eight per chirality schedule; each slot carries one Axis-6 sign, while Ti, Te, Fi, and Fe are substages and native is emphasis metadata rather than an admissibility filter.
The finite source table supplies the exact slot, engine, loop, step, terrain, Axis-6 sign, and native-emphasis metadata consumed by the selector.
The predecessor reports a Type-2 order failure and explicitly requires the next discriminator to remove the count-four premise and use noncommuting entropy-moving legs.

primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: This object is the finite falsification test for the four-beat and order premise. It enumerates every oriented cyclic schedule from length two through length eight over the declared four source operators, including schedules that repeat an operator or omit operators. It scores no authored target and treats a four-beat result as selected only when the same unique cycle clears the fixed margin and frequency gates for both source chirality schedules while destructive controls remain capable of killing that result.

native_terms.source slot: One row of the sixteen-row source schedule carrying engine chirality, loop role, terrain, step, one Axis-6 sign, and native-emphasis metadata.
native_terms.oriented necklace: A cyclic operator word quotiented only by cyclic rotation, with reversal retained as a distinct order and all cyclic phases averaged during scoring.
native_terms.scientific RED: The preregistered selection criterion failed or a required physical or destructive control gate failed, without implying an execution or artifact-integrity failure.

weirdness_signature: Four is a candidate outcome rather than a supplied word length.
Repeated and omitted operators remain legal candidates throughout selection.
Type1 and Type2 chirality order remains distinct from every per-slot Axis-6 precedence sign.
Native operator metadata cannot root, filter, or reward a candidate schedule.

primary_object_card.codomain_or_output: Per-scenario complete winner sets and margins, aggregate shared-cycle frequency, physical-leg receipts, destructive-control verdicts, and a bounded RED or source-family-only selection verdict.

method_contracts.baseline_preservation: Preserve the frozen preregistration and complete candidate baseline while debugging runtime or batching details.
method_contracts.falsifier_first: The target is a shared unique length-four cycle; the strongest falsifier is any other winner, tie, small margin, control survival, or physical-leg failure; raw scenario checks classify it killed, open, or survived.
method_contracts.feynman_testability: The operation composes finite signed channels, the observables are geometry contrast and relative-entropy movement, and the pass/fail condition is the fixed cross-type frequency and margin rule.
method_contracts.synthesis_refusal: Synthesis must refuse to merge artifact validity with scientific success, or source-family selection with universal emergence.
method_contracts.human_offload: Resolve all reproducible source, runtime, enumeration, validation, and hashing work with tools before asking the user.
